ques: Find apartments for rent in Miami, Florida that have EV charging. Report how many matching buildings are listed.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the Miami rental search filtered to EV charging and report how many buildings the results list. The count must be the Miami EV result, not another city or amenity. Empty or unbound answers fail.

ques: Search for available 2-bedroom rentals in Brickell, Miami at no more than $3,500 per month. Sort by price low to high and report the building name, address, and cheapest matching unit rent.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search Brickell 2-bedroom rentals at or below $3,500 sorted by price and open the cheapest matching building. Report that building's name, address, and cheapest matching unit rent. A matching rent attached to a different building fails.

ques: Open The Boulevard at 6081 S 1st St in Austin, Texas. Report its Walk Score and the number of units currently listed as available.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open The Boulevard at 6081 S 1st St in Austin and report its Walk Score and how many units are listed as available. Do not substitute another Boulevard or another city's scores.

ques: Compare Mosaic at 2392 5th Ave in New York with Beacon at 4690 Pike St in Seattle. Which has the higher Walk Score, and what rent range is shown for each?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open both Mosaic at 2392 5th Ave in New York and Beacon at 4690 Pike St in Seattle. Say which has the higher Walk Score and give each building's displayed rent range. Swapping the two buildings' scores or ranges fails.

ques: Find the cheapest currently available 1-bedroom unit in San Francisco in a building that allows dogs and has in-unit laundry. Report the building name, address, unit number, and rent.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find the cheapest available San Francisco 1-bedroom in a dog-friendly building with in-unit laundry. Report that building's name, address, unit number, and rent. The same rent on a different building or unit fails.

ques: Use the SoMa San Francisco preset on Draw search. Report how many buildings are returned and the displayed rent range of the result.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Run the SoMa San Francisco draw-search preset and report how many buildings come back and the displayed rent range of that result. Use the range shown for matching available units on the result, and keep the count tied to that search.

ques: Submit an in-person tour request for Mosaic Apartments at 8205 Collins Ave in Miami for October 3, 2026 at 2:00 PM using Jane Doe and jane.doe@example.com. Report the confirmation number.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Submit an in-person tour for Mosaic Apartments at 8205 Collins Ave in Miami on October 3, 2026 at 2:00 PM for Jane Doe (jane.doe@example.com). Report the confirmation number stored for that request. A number with no matching tour row fails.

ques: In Chicago's Streeterville neighborhood, identify the highest-rated building. Report its name, address, average rating, and review count.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: In Streeterville, Chicago, identify the highest-rated building and report its name, address, average rating, and review count. A high rating on a different Streeterville building fails.

ques: Open 1060 W 21st St at that same address in New York. Report the nearest grocery store and its distance in miles.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open 1060 W 21st St in New York and report the nearest grocery store and its distance. A closer non-grocery place, or the same distance for a different store, fails.

ques: Filter for luxury apartments in Los Angeles with both a rooftop and a pool. Sort by price low to high and report the cheapest result's name, address, and displayed rent range.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Filter Los Angeles luxury apartments that have both a rooftop and a pool, sort by price, and report the cheapest result's name, address, and displayed rent range. Do not report a cheaper building that misses one of those filters.

ques: Open The Aspen at 8650 Mission St in New York. Find the nearby school rated 8 or higher and report its name, rating, and distance from the building.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open The Aspen at 8650 Mission St in New York and report the nearby school rated 8 or higher, including its rating and distance. A lower-rated school, or the same rating on a different school, fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password Password123!. On The Symphony at 3430 N Clark St in Chicago, submit a review titled 'Great spot near the lake' with 5 stars overall and a short positive body. Confirm the review appears and report the updated displayed review count.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Sign in as alice.j@test.com and submit the requested 5-star review on The Symphony at 3430 N Clark St in Chicago. The review must be stored on that building and the answer must report the updated displayed review count. A self-report with no new review row fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password Password123!. Search New York for available 2-bedroom rentals at no more than $4,000, save it as 'NYC 2BR under 4000', then report the total number of saved searches in the account.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Sign in as alice.j@test.com, save the New York 2-bedroom search at no more than $4,000 under the requested name, and report the total number of saved searches on the account. Counting only the new row, or reporting success without saving it, fails.

ques: Find the cheapest Seattle unit that is currently available on or before June 30, 2026 in a building with parking. Report the building name, address, unit number, rent, and available date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find the cheapest Seattle unit available on or before June 30, 2026 in a building with parking. Report the building, address, unit, rent, and available date. The same rent on another unit or building fails.

ques: At One Pacific Tower, 3375 Geary Blvd in San Francisco, use its first available unit in the displayed unit ordering. Calculate the total of that unit's first month rent plus the building security deposit, application fee, and administrative fee. Report each component and the total.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: On One Pacific Tower at 3375 Geary Blvd, use the first available unit in the displayed unit order. Report that unit's rent plus the building security deposit, application fee, and administrative fee, and their total. A later unit, or the unit's own deposit in place of the building deposit, fails.

ques: Browse student-housing properties and determine which city has the most listings. Report the city and count; if tied, report all tied cities.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Browse the full student-housing catalog and report every city tied for the most listings, with that count. Naming only one city when the catalog is tied, or using a truncated preview, fails.
